from rdkit import Chem
from rdkit.Chem import AllChem, rdMolDescriptors
from rdkit.Geometry import Point3D
# atoms: B0-5; 6 phenolic O;7 ether O;8 Cg;9 Cf;10 Ce;11 Cd;12 Ca;13 Cb;14 Cc;15 N;16 methyl;17 C10;18 C11;19 C12;20 OH; explicit stereochemical H atoms 21-23 on Ce, Cf, Cg
rw=Chem.RWMol()
labels=['C','C','C','C','C','C','O','O','C','C','C','C','C','C','C','N','C','C','C','C','O','H','H','H']
for sym in labels:
 a=Chem.Atom(sym)
 if sym=='C' and len(rw.GetAtoms())<=5: a.SetIsAromatic(True)
 rw.AddAtom(a)
# bonds
bonds=[(0,1,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(1,2,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(2,3,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(3,4,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(4,5,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),(5,0,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),
 (0,6,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(5,7,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(7,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(9,4,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(4,3,Chem.BondType.AROMATIC),
 (9,10,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(10,11,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(11,12,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(12,13,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(13,14,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(14,15,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,11,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(11,10,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
 (10,17,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(17,18,Chem.BondType.DOUBLE),(18,19,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(19,8,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,9,Chem.BondType.SINGLE), (19,20,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(15,16,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),
 (10,21,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(9,22,Chem.BondType.SINGLE),(8,23,Chem.BondType.SINGLE)]
# remove duplicates from list (9,4) and aromatic 4,3 duplicate
seen=set()
for i,j,t in bonds:
 key=tuple(sorted((i,j)))
 if key in seen: continue
 seen.add(key)
 rw.AddBond(i,j,t)
m=rw.GetMol()
# coordinates in drawing coords (Y positive down); set coords for actual atoms
coords=[(212,263),(212,142),(316,81),(420,141),(420,262),(316,322),(145,298),(379,442),(524,442),(524,322),(627,262),(627,141),(524,81),(584,94),(627,20),(730,85),(860,85),(732,322),(732,442),(627,502),(627,610),(690,220),(524,220),(524,555)]
conf=Chem.Conformer(m.GetNumAtoms())
for i,(x,y) in enumerate(coords): conf.SetAtomPosition(i,Point3D(x,-y,0))
m.AddConformer(conf)
# wedge bonds must be direction from center toward ligand. center->ligand bond begin in ordered direction.
def setdir(i,j,dir):
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j)
 # bond begin index orientation; if begin != i reverse dir
 if b.GetBeginAtomIdx()!=i:
  dir={Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE:Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH:Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE}[dir]
 b.SetBondDir(dir)
setdir(11,15,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH) # N dashed at Cd
setdir(10,21,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
setdir(9,22,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
setdir(8,23,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH)
setdir(19,20,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('before',Chem.MolToSmiles(m),rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print(a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'),a.GetChiralTag())
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True)
print('formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m), 'n',m.GetNumAtoms(),Chem.MolToSmiles(Chem.RemoveHs(m)))
# embed conformer constrained? currently 2d coords, better use ETKDG starting 2d? use EmbedMolecule creates 3d respecting assigned stereo
m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3(); p.randomSeed=173; p.useSmallRingTorsions=True
r=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p); print('embed',r)
if r<0:
 r=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,randomSeed=173)
print('3d',r)
print('MMFF',AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m))
if AllChem.MMFFHasAllMoleculeParams(m):
 AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)
AllChem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.HasProp('_CIPCode'): print('CIP',a.GetIdx(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode'))
conf=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\n3D structure from 2D drawing; MMFF optimized\n')
 for atom in m.GetAtoms():
  p=conf.GetAtomPosition(atom.GetIdx())
  f.write(f'{atom.GetSymbol()} {p.x:.6f} {p.y:.6f} {p.z:.6f}\n')

coords=[(212,263),(212,142),(316,81),(420,141),(420,262),(316,322),(145,298),(379,442),(524,442),(524,322),(627,262),(627,141),(524,81),(584,94),(627,20),(730,85),(860,85),(732,322),(732,442),(627,502),(627,610),(690,220),(524,220),(524,555),(680,170)]

m.AddConformer(c)
def sd(i,j,d):
 b=m.GetBondBetweenAtoms(i,j)
 if b.GetBeginAtomIdx()!=i:d={Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE:Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH:Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE}[d]
 b.SetBondDir(d)
sd(11,15,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH); sd(10,21,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH);sd(9,22,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH);sd(8,23,Chem.BondDir.BEGINDASH);sd(19,20,Chem.BondDir.BEGINWEDGE)
Chem.AssignChiralTypesFromBondDirs(m,confId=0,replaceExistingTags=True)
Chem.AssignStereochemistry(m,cleanIt=True,force=True)
print('formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),'smiles',Chem.MolToSmiles(m))
for a in m.GetAtoms():
 if a.GetChiralTag()!=Chem.ChiralType.CHI_UNSPECIFIED:print('chiral tag',a.GetIdx(),a.GetSymbol(),a.GetChiralTag(),a.GetProp('_CIPCode') if a.HasProp('_CIPCode') else '')
m=Chem.AddHs(m,addCoords=True);m.RemoveAllConformers()
p=AllChem.ETKDGv3();p.randomSeed=154;p.useSmallRingTorsions=True
ret=AllChem.EmbedMolecule(m,p);print('embed',ret,'formula',rdMolDescriptors.CalcMolFormula(m),'natoms',m.GetNumAtoms())
if ret<0:raise RuntimeError('3D embedding failed')
AllChem.MMFFOptimizeMolecule(m,maxIters=1000)

c=m.GetConformer()
with open('answer.xyz','w') as f:
 f.write(f'{m.GetNumAtoms()}\nMolecule built from 2D drawing; MMFF optimized\n')
 for a in m.GetAtoms():
